title: Law to create residential parking permits in parts of the Bronx
summary: This bill would require the Department of Transportation to set up a residential parking permit system in Bronx community districts 1, 2, 3, 9 and 10. Streets next to commercial, office or retail properties would be excluded, at least 20 percent of spaces would remain open to non-residents for short-term parking of at least 90 minutes, and residents would pay a fee for permits. Certain vehicles would be exempt, and the law would take effect 120 days after passage.
